## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run verify` passes.
- [ ] Changes to capture, audio, export, playback or packaging: `bun run verify:release` passes, or I said which parts I couldn't run and why.
- [ ] I tried it in the real app, with real footage where it matters, not only in tests.
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot or short recording below.
- [ ] I didn't bump the version in `package.json`. The maintainer does that when releasing.
- [ ] I understand every line I'm submitting, including any written with AI tools, and I can explain it in review.

Tested on:

- [ ] Windows

- [ ] macOS
